policies.title: Dominican ordinary passports: Tanzania visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Tanzania Immigration's current named schedule includes the Dominican Republic in the cohort eligible for either online processing or a visa at an official entry point.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Dominican passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The official guidance expressly permits either online processing or a visa on arrival; this is normalized as visa_on_arrival because issuance at an official entry point is directly available.
The guide says visa on arrival is available at an official entry point and separately requires six-month passport validity and a return ticket.

policies.title: South Sudanese ordinary passports: Tanzania EAC visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Tanzania Immigration's current guide says EAC Member State nationals do not require a visa, and the current EAC site identifies South Sudan and Tanzania as Partner States.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary South Sudanese passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Immigration guide does not state a common stay duration or work entitlement; this policy concerns the visa requirement only.

unresolved.reason: Nicaragua is absent from Tanzania's current named visa-on-arrival, referral and visa-free groups. No current official source states an exhaustive ordinary-passport default, so no route is inferred from the general portal.
